hearthroot_dyes.name: Ilse's Dyeworks
hearthroot_dyes.greeting: A cloak says who you are before you do. What color are you today?

hearthroot_arms.name: Hearthroot Arms
hearthroot_arms.greeting: Steel for the roots, wanderer. Pick what keeps you breathing.

hearthroot_items.name: Hearthroot Sundries
hearthroot_items.greeting: Keys, fruit and dew. All honest, mostly.

amberlee_armor.name: Amberlee Armory
amberlee_armor.greeting: Back from the dark, are we? Then you'll want thicker skin.

amberlee_items.name: Amberlee Provisions
amberlee_items.greeting: The sap's gone hard and so have my prices. Mostly.

kettleforge_smith.name: Kettleforge Forge
kettleforge_smith.greeting: Free hands make good steel. Show me that blade of yours, elf.

kettleforge_items.name: The Kettleforge Larder
kettleforge_items.greeting: Dried meat for the climb and a Silver Key for the vaults. The deep galleries kept everything but our appetite.

hearthroot_charts.name: Maps and Charts
hearthroot_charts.greeting: Lost already? Every tunnel I have walked is on these, and a few I only heard about.

kettleforge_charts.name: Kettleforge Survey
kettleforge_charts.greeting: Dwarves chart what they dig. Three years in hiding, and I drew every gallery from memory.

sylvarre_items.name: Sylvarre Provisions
sylvarre_items.greeting: Dew and fruit from the high boughs, and ointment the wardens swear by.

sylvarre_charts.name: Skywatch Charts
sylvarre_charts.greeting: From the boughs you can see half the Tree. I drew what I saw, and a bit of what the fog let me.

spires_armor.name: Stormward Armory
spires_armor.greeting: Plate for the sky road. The lightning finds iron, so we forge ours from elf-silver.

spires_scrolls.name: The Bell-Tower Scriptorium
spires_scrolls.greeting: Every scroll here was copied by lamplight while the storm rang the bells.

spires_items.name: Carillon Stores
spires_items.greeting: Dry bread, dry wicks, and ointment for the hail.

spires_charts.name: Bell-Ringer's Charts
spires_charts.greeting: From the bell loft you can see every isle the wind has not hidden.

vorrhallow_charts.name: Sounding-Line Charts
vorrhallow_charts.greeting: Forty years I swam these halls by memory. Now the water's down, I can draw them dry.

lampwick_keys.name: Odo's Keys and Sundries
lampwick_keys.greeting: Every lock in the Haar, I have cut a key for. Most of them still turn.

lampwick_charts.name: Fogwalker's Charts
lampwick_charts.greeting: I walked the Haar blind for thirty years. Here is what my feet remember.

polesend_scrolls.name: Orla's Scrolls
polesend_scrolls.greeting: A scroll of Emberfall, wanderer? It dries the bramble and the damp alike. Few in Polesend can afford to be without it.

polesend_items.name: Brannagh's Stores
polesend_items.greeting: Smoked eel, salve, and keys off the drowned. Don't ask whose.

vorrhallow_keys.name: Sigrun's Locks
vorrhallow_keys.greeting: Every door in the king's city had its key, and every key passed through my hands. The water kept them bright.
